name: Kreuzberge

hero.subtitle_html: Wasserauen → Seealpsee → Saxer Lücke → Kreuzberge — SAC T3 · ~1250 m gain · ~15 km · ~7.5 h

intro_html: This example shows the main reason `route_build` accepts waypoint objects with explicit coordinates: Alpstein names can be ambiguous or inconsistently tagged in OSM. For parallel agents, explicit `lat/lon` values on key waypoints remove wasted retries and make the route build deterministic.
quick_facts: Big limestone day with lake + cliff scenery

getting_there.by_pt_html:
• Train via Appenzell to Wasserauen.
  • Short walk from station to trail start.
getting_there.by_car_html: Drive to Wasserauen and park at the valley station / trailhead lots.

weather.season_html: Best window: July to early October in dry conditions.

lapse_rate.example_html: Example: 21 °C in Wasserauen → roughly 13 °C on the high limestone terraces.
